IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF COOK COUNTY, ILLINOIS
COUNTY DEPARTMENT, LAW DIVISION

RIDGELINE AEROSPACE COMPONENTS, INC.,

                         Plaintiff,

v.                                                    Case No. 2026 L 009812

HALLORAN PRECISION CASTINGS, LLC,

                         Defendant.

COMPLAINT AT LAW AND DEMAND FOR JURY TRIAL

Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc., by its attorneys, complains of Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC as follows.

PARTIES

1. Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc. is a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business in Rockford, Illinois.

2. Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC is a Connecticut limited liability company with its principal place of business in Waterbury, Connecticut.

JURISDICTION AND VENUE

3. This Court has jurisdiction over Defendant because Defendant transacted business within Illinois and the claims arise from that business, pursuant to 735 ILCS 5/2-209.

4. Venue is proper in Cook County under 735 ILCS 5/2-101 because the transaction giving rise to the claims occurred in substantial part in this county.

FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS

5. Between March and July 2025, Defendant supplied Plaintiff with 4,200 turbine housings under Purchase Order No. RA-2025-0148.

6. The housings were required to conform to dimensional tolerances stated in drawing RA-88412, revision C.

7. In August 2025, Plaintiff's customer reported dimensional nonconformity in assemblies incorporating the housings.

8. Plaintiff conducted a recall of the affected assemblies at a cost of $2,340,000.

COUNT I — BREACH OF CONTRACT

9. Plaintiff realleges paragraphs 1 through 8 as though fully set forth herein.

10. Defendant breached the Purchase Order by delivering nonconforming goods.

11. As a direct and proximate result, Plaintiff has been damaged in an amount exceeding $2,340,000.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc. respectfully requests that this Court enter judgment in its favor and against Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC in an amount in excess of $2,340,000, together with costs and such other relief as the Court deems just.

JURY DEMAND

Plaintiff demands trial by jury on all issues so triable.

                                        Respectfully submitted,

                                        /s/ Yusuf Adeyemi
                                        Yusuf Adeyemi
                                        KEARNS & WHITLOCK LLP
